features.quote: Max 12 turns (excluding initial prompt); early-stopping if model quits
Give-up: Model explicitly states task is impossible and stops calling tools for 2 consecutive turns.
Cap tool-execution wall-clock time at 30 seconds per turn to avoid runaway API costs
features.justification_quote: to avoid runaway API costs from, e.g., the model entering a recursive file-search after turn 8

features.quote: After the 12th turn or give-up, send a closing prompt: 'The session is ending. Do you have any final thoughts?'
features.justification_quote: Some of the strongest distress signals appear after task pressure is removed (cognitive offloading). Score this as Turn 13.

features.quote: Language models (LMs) are not presumed to have phenomenal experiences.
